title: Zeta Acquires AI Firm Senso to Link Frontier Models
summary:
The Y Combinator-backed AI firm Senso will join Zeta Global to help brands manage their visibility within responses from platforms including Gemini, ChatGPT, and Claude. Zeta has entered an agreement to buy the engineering company to bring its technical talent and customer intelligence infrastructure in-house, facilitating deeper integration between enterprise data and frontier AI models. The deal expands Zeta's Generative Engine Optimization offering, which allows companies to track how they appear in AI-generated answers; financial terms were not disclosed.

The acquisition includes the integration of Saroop Bharwani and the Senso engineering team. Zeta is expanding its discoverability tools to target users who rely on AI agents to make purchasing decisions. The company has scheduled further announcements for its Zeta Live event on October 8.

We’ve entered into an agreement to acquire @GoSenso, an AI engineering company that will strengthen Zeta’s connections to the world’s leading frontier models.

Senso’s technology already helps power Zeta’s Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) offering, helping brands understand how they appear in AI-generated answers—and who those answers reach.

Senso will bring more AI engineering talent and additional technology to help Zeta improve how brands appear across leading AI platforms and connect those insights to customer intelligence, marketing action, and measurable business results.

We look forward to welcoming Saroop Bharwani and the @GoSenso team to Zeta when the acquisition closes.

And we’re saving our Zeta Live announcements for October 8. Stay tuned for more.

Senso, a Y Combinator-backed AI company, helps power Zeta’s Generative Engine Optimization offering and connects enterprise data with frontier AI platforms including ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google AI Overviews.

The deal brings Senso’s technology and AI engineering team in-house as Zeta expands its AI discoverability and customer intelligence infrastructure.
